purpose: Teach: 解い/こぼれ/海老/くれぐれも/元旦/眠気/病人/想い出

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼との悩み、ようやく、自分で、解いた感じよ、最近、本当に、相談、乗ってくれて、ありがとうね、感謝してる。
lines.en: Aoi, I finally worked through that worry about my boyfriend on my own. You've been so good to talk to about everything lately—I'm really grateful.
lines.style: Warm, relieved opening. Soft gratitude on 「ありがとう」. Pace is unhurried. Natural exhale of someone who's come through something small but real.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新作のお皿、コーヒーが、こぼれそうな、デザインなのよ、葵、メイちゃん、見てみて、面白いよ、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah? I got these new plates in—the design's kind of funny, they look like the coffee's about to spill right off. You have to see them. Really amusing.
lines.style: Genuine brightness without forcing it. Leans forward slightly on 「面白い」. Quick, conversational pace. The energy of someone who wants to show something she noticed and thinks the other person will get the joke.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祝いに、海老料理、彼、出してくれたわよ、本当に、嬉しい夜だったわ、葵、私、感動しちゃった、本当に、すごい人ね。
lines.en: For a little celebration, he actually made me shrimp—one of my favorite dishes. It was such a happy night. I got a little emotional, honestly. He's really something special.
lines.style: Tender, slightly awed. Softness on 「嬉しい」. Pause before 「感動」—surprise at her own feeling. Trailing warmth at the end. The voice of someone still sitting with the goodness of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、くれぐれも、無理しないでね、葵としても、本当に、心配してるわよ、最近、忙しすぎる感じ、するから、本当に。
lines.en: Mei, promise me you won't push yourself too hard, okay? From my end I'm genuinely worried. You've seemed so busy lately, and I want you to take care of yourself.
lines.style: Gentle firmness underneath. No condescension, just steady care. Slight lean-in on 「心配」. Slower pace on the second half—making sure it lands. The tone of someone who knows her friend well enough to say it straight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 元旦の朝、葵で、特別なメニュー、出すんでしょ?私、絶対、行くわよ、本当に、楽しみだよ、葵、待ってるからね。
lines.en: Wait, you're doing a special menu on New Year's morning? I'm definitely coming. I'm really looking forward to it. I can't wait.
lines.style: Immediate warmth and anticipation. Quick uptake on the question. Brightness climbs on 「楽しみ」. Straightforward excitement—no hedging, just genuine. Lands on 「待ってる」 with affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、私、眠気で、運転、気をつけないと、と、思ってるの、葵で、新しい車、買って、本当に、気を引き締めてるよ。
lines.en: Actually, I've been thinking lately—with how tired I get, I need to be more careful driving. I bought a new car recently, and I'm trying to stay sharp, you know? Keep myself focused.
lines.style: Thoughtful, a little vulnerable. Opens with slight hesitation on 「眠気」. Then steadies—quiet determination on 「気を引き締める」. Measured pace. The voice of someone being honest about something that bothers her but not dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店、病人さんも、いらっしゃるんでしょ、お子様連れも、配慮、本当に、いき届いてるよね、葵、感心するわよ、いつも。
lines.en: You know, the way you run your café—you have patients who come in, people with kids, and you notice everything they need. The care you put into it is really something. I admire it.
lines.style: Sincere, observant. Steady admiration without flattery. Pace is warm and unhurried. Slight emphasis on 「いき届いてる」—the recognition of specificity. Lands with genuine respect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃんとの想い出、本当に、たくさん、あるわよね、葵、感謝してる、ずっと、お友達でいてね、本当に、心から、お願い。
lines.en: I have so many memories with you. I'm grateful for all of them. Will you stay my friend? I'm asking this with my whole heart—really, truly.
lines.style: Quiet depth, vulnerable. Softens on 「想い出」. Real pause before 「心から」—this is the thing she's saying that matters. Slow, intentional delivery. Barely above a whisper at the close, like a prayer.
